scripts.lint: redocly lint openapi/ticket-service.yaml openapi/payment-service.yaml openapi/ledger-service.yaml openapi/gateway.yaml
scripts.generate: openapi-typescript openapi/ticket-service.yaml -o src/generated/ticket-service.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/payment-service.yaml -o src/generated/payment-service.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/ledger-service.yaml -o src/generated/ledger-service.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/gateway.yaml -o src/generated/gateway.ts
scripts.bundle: redocly bundle openapi/ticket-service.yaml --dereferenced --ext json -o dist/ticket-service.json && redocly bundle openapi/payment-service.yaml --dereferenced --ext json -o dist/payment-service.json
